UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information stored in Firestore for Scene Hai?

displayName.description: User display name shown across the app

bio.description: Short user bio or intro, max 160 characters

city.description: Primary city for local scenes (e.g. Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad)

interests.description: Categories of activities the user is interested in

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update

Scene.title: Scene
Scene.description: Real scene or meetup created by a host in Scene Hai?

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator

hostDisplayName.description: Snapshot of host display name from profile at creation time

title.description: Title of the plan (5 to 70 characters)

description.description: Detailed description of expectations and vibe (15 to 500 characters)

city.description: Target city in Pakistan (e.g. Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad)

venue.description: General meetup place description (not exact private address)

budgetPerPerson.description: Estimated cost per person in PKR

maxParticipants.description: Maximum number of attendees allowed (2 to 100)

approvedCount.description: Number of approved participants excluding the host (0 to maxParticipants - 1)

JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest
JoinRequest.description: Real join request submitted by a user for an upcoming scene in Scene Hai?

requesterId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the requester

requesterDisplayName.description: Snapshot of requester display name from their profile

status.description: Current status of the join request

decidedAt.description: Server timestamp when decision was made by host

decidedBy.description: Host UID who approved, declined, or removed this request

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was initially created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was last updated

ScenePrivateDetails.title: ScenePrivateDetails
ScenePrivateDetails.description: Confidential meetup details (exact venue address, host notes) readable only by the host and approved attendees

venue.description: Exact venue address or meetup instructions

hostNotes.description: Optional host instructions or contact info

SceneMessage.title: SceneMessage
SceneMessage.description: Real-time group chat message within an active scene

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message sender

senderDisplayName.description: Snapshot of sender display name from their profile

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent

NotificationState.title: NotificationState
NotificationState.description: Read status record for an in-app notification for the user

notificationId.description: Deterministic ID of the notification marked as read

readAt.description: Server timestamp when notification was marked as read

NotificationEvent.title: NotificationEvent
NotificationEvent.description: Append-only immutable event record delivered to a user's notification feed

recipientId.description: UID of the user receiving the notification

actorId.description: UID of the authenticated user who initiated the event

actorName.description: Display name snapshot of the actor

actionRoute.description: Target app route (e.g. my-scenes or scene/:id)

read.description: Whether recipient has viewed or marked this notification as read

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was triggered

/users/{userId}.description: Persistent Cloud Firestore user profiles indexed by Firebase Auth UID. Each user can only read and write their own profile.

/users/{userId}/notificationStates/{noti.description: User notification read states. Only the authenticated user can read and create their own notification read records.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Persistent append-only notification events delivered to the recipient. Reversible transitions cannot delete historical notifications.

/scenes/{sceneId}.description: Real scenes and meetups. Public active scenes are readable by anyone. Hosts can read, update, or cancel their own scenes.

/scenes/{sceneId}/joinRequests/{requeste.description: Real join requests for a scene indexed by requester UID. Requesters can create, view, withdraw, and re-submit their request. Hosts can view requests for their hosted scenes.

/scenes/{sceneId}/privateDetails/{detail.description: Exact meetup location and private host notes accessible ONLY by the host and approved participants.

/scenes/{sceneId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time group chat messages for a scene. Readable and writable only by the scene host or approved attendees.
